steps.description:
Draw a square with length 100 pixels using a for-loop.

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)
steps.answer:
import turtle
myscreen = turtle.Screen()
mypen = turtle.Turtle()

for i in range(4):
    mypen.forward(100)
    mypen.left(90)

steps.description:
An equilateral triangle is a triangle with 3 equal sides. Draw an equilateral triangle with edge length 100 pixels using a for-loop.

Hint: - The external angle of an equilateral triangle is 120 degrees.

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)
steps.answer:
import turtle
myscreen = turtle.Screen()
mypen = turtle.Turtle()

for i in range(3):
    mypen.forward(100)
    mypen.left(120)
